```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % ent1 "<!ENTITY ent2 'expanded-entity'>">
  %ent1;
  <!ENTITY ext SYSTEM "nonexistent.ent">
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY imgdata SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
<root xmlns="http://example.com/ns/root" xmlns:sub="http://example.com/ns/sub" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- This is a top-level comment combining CDATA and entities -->
  <sub:child xlink:type="simple">
    <![CDATA[
      Some raw CDATA text with &ent2; inside.
    ]]>
  </sub:child>
  <child>&ext;</child>
</root>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (item*)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % param "CDATA">
  <!ENTITY base "BaseEntity">
  <!ENTITY complex "&base; &base;">
  <!NOTATION pdf SYSTEM "application/pdf">
  <!ENTITY manual SYSTEM "manual.pdf" NDATA pdf>
]>
<?xml-processing-instruction target="compiler" action="build"?>
<catalog xmlns="http://example.org/catalog" xmlns:m="http://example.org/org" xmlns:xi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XInclude">
  <!-- Comment containing DTD references &base; -->
  <m:item>
    <?pi-target data="value"?>
    <![CDATA[
      Nested CDATA block with unescaped <tags> & attributes.
    ]]>
    &complex;
  </m:item>
</catalog>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE archive [
  <!ELEMENT archive (record)*>
  <!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY entA "Value A">
  <!ENTITY entB "Value B &entA;">
  <!ENTITY % internal "<!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA)>">
  %internal;
  <!NOTATION txt SYSTEM "text/plain">
  <!ENTITY notes SYSTEM "notes.txt" NDATA txt>
]>
<?xml-target-pi data="test-mode"?>
<archive xmlns="http://xml.example.com/archive" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/">
  <!-- Archive description comment -->
  <dc:title>Test Archive</dc:title>
  <record xlink:type="simple">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA content section.
    ]]>
    &entB;
  </record>
</archive>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE document [
  <!ELEMENT document (section)*>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY e1 "First Entity">
  <!ENTITY e2 "Second &e1;">
  <!ENTITY e3 "Third &e2;">
  <!ENTITY % dtdMacro "<!ENTITY macroEntity 'MacroText'>">
  %dtdMacro;
  <!NOTATION tiff SYSTEM "image/tiff">
  <!ENTITY sample SYSTEM "sample.tiff" NDATA tiff>
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/css" href="style.css"?>
<document xmlns="http://schemas.example.com/doc" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xsi:schemaLocation="http://schemas.example.com/doc doc.xsd">
  <!-- Multiple nested entities and comments -->
  <section>
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA section containing &e3; reference text.
    ]]>
    ¯oEntity;
  </section>
</document>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE container [
  <!ELEMENT container (data)*>
  <!ELEMENT data (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY token "TokenValue">
  <!ENTITY ref "&token; and more">
  <!ENTITY % extParam SYSTEM "external.ent">
  %extParam;
  <!NOTATION audio SYSTEM "audio/basic">
  <!ENTITY sound SYSTEM "sound.au" NDATA audio>
]>
<?xml-server-info host="localhost" port="8080"?>
<container xmlns="http://example.org/container" xmlns:ns="http://example.org/ns" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- Comment before complex elements -->
  <ns:data xlink:type="extended">
    <![CDATA[
      Complex CDATA with entities like &ref; inside.
    ]]>
  </ns:data>
</container>
```
